item.title: Fallout from Chavez investigation prompts urgent vote to repeal Minnesota holiday
item.description: Lawmakers moved quickly to address the fallout from sexual abuse allegations against Cesar Chavez, putting a bill to repeal his state holiday on the fast track.

item.title: White Bear Lake fatal fire: No evidence fire was intentionally set
item.description: Firefighters say there is no evidence that suggests the fire that ripped through a White Bear Lake home, which claimed the lives of a beloved hockey reporter and her three children, was intentionally set.

item.title: Bruce Springsteen to perform at No Kings rally on March 28 in St. Paul
item.description: Bruce Springsteen has been added to a star-studded lineup, joining major political figures, for the No Kings rally at the Minnesota State Capitol on Saturday, March 28.

item.title: Woman dies in Minneapolis hit-and-run crash, driver still at large
item.description: A woman hit by a vehicle that fled the scene in Minneapolis over the weekend died Monday from her injuries, according to Police Chief Brian O’Hara.

item.title: Southwestern Minnesota crash kills 5, injures 9 during birthday celebration
item.description: New details are emerging about a deadly crash in southwestern Minnesota that left five people dead and several families grieving.

item.title: White Bear Lake community unites in grief at concert after tragedies
item.description: A grief concert brought the White Bear Lake community together Monday night just days after even more tragic losses touched the city.

item.title: Voices for Change: New journal aims to support Black men's mental health
item.description: A new journal aims to make it easier for Black men to talk about their mental health and find support. Josh Cobb, who has managed chronic depression and anxiety for most of his life, says journaling has been a lifeline for him.

item.title: Minnesota weather: Quiet and warmer Tuesday with filtered sunshine
item.description: A quiet and mild Tuesday brings filtered sunshine and above-average temperatures in the 50s across much of Minnesota.

item.title: Minnesota Gophers men's hockey hiring St. Cloud State coach Brett Larson
item.description: The Minnesota Gophers have their next men's hockey coach. Sources tell FOX 9's Jim Rich that St. Cloud State coach Brett Larson will be named head coach on Tuesday.

item.title: St. Paul man charged in deadly hit-and-run crash that killed woman
item.description: A St. Paul man has been charged in connection with a hit-and-run that left a 58-year-old woman dead. The driver claimed his car had been stolen, but never reported it to the police.
